description: This update brings a smarter feed with dedicated sections for Top Animes, Ongoing Animes, Top Drama, and Trending. You can now tap View All on any row to see everything in that category in a full grid. Startup sync is also faster and more resilient on slow networks.
features: Feed is now split into sections: Top Animes, Ongoing Animes, Top Drama, Random, Trending
Tap View All on any section to open the full grid
New 'ongoing' detection based on item status from the server
Smarter thumbnail decoding — less memory, faster scrolling
Automatic retry with countdown when the network is slow
fixes: Fixed a case where the feed stayed empty after a failed sync
Fixed crash when reopening the app during a sync
Fixed Drama metadata failing on first launch
Reduced duplicate network calls on cold start
